summary: The constant rename left two importers referring to a name that no longer exists.

findings.title: client still passes the removed DEFAULT_TIMEOUT name
findings.body: The rename to `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` migrated `http.py`, but this module still does `from aws_lambda_powertools.shared.constants import DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`, which no longer exists — so importing it raises ImportError. Fix: use the new name in the import and at this call site.

findings.title: server still passes the removed DEFAULT_TIMEOUT name
findings.body: The same rename, second call site: this module also imports `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` and passes it here, so importing it raises ImportError. Fixing one importer without the other leaves the code broken, so the two changes are one fix.
